summary: Implement and verify locale-aware content, formatting, RTL/LTR layout, mixed-direction text, controls, accessibility, and human translation review.
triggers: An interface needs locale-aware behavior or a new language.
RTL/LTR layout, mixed text, formatting, icons, or keyboard behavior is inconsistent.
Localized UI changes need screenshots, interaction checks, and human language review.
antiTriggers: Publish machine translation without human review.
Mirror directional icons or data semantics indiscriminately.
Assume one locale screenshot proves all language, width, or assistive states.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Locale, direction, formatting, accessibility, human-review, and failure semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no translation or cultural qualification is asserted.
